home.hero_subtitle: Share your rides, reduce your carbon footprint and save money. Join the EcoRide community today.
home.how_subtitle: Find your carpool in 3 simple steps
home.step1_desc: Enter your departure city, destination and preferred date
home.step2_desc: Choose the perfect driver and book with one click
home.step3_desc: Enjoy a friendly ride that's good for the planet
home.features_subtitle: A platform designed to make carpooling simple, affordable and eco-friendly
home.feature_eco_desc: Reduce your carbon footprint by sharing rides with fellow travelers
home.feature_eco_highlight: Up to 75% less CO₂ per trip
home.feature_economical_desc: Share travel costs and save significantly on your commutes
home.feature_economical_highlight: Save an average of €40 per trip
home.feature_social_desc: Meet new people and build connections during your journeys
home.feature_safe_desc: Verified profiles, passenger reviews and rating system for safe travel
home.feature_electric_desc: Filter for electric vehicles and be part of tomorrow's mobility
home.feature_flex_desc: Free cancellation and automatic credit refund at any time
home.eco_description: Every shared trip is a concrete action for the planet. Our community actively contributes to reducing CO₂ emissions.
home.testimonials_subtitle: Discover the experiences of our carpooling community
home.testimonial1_text: "EcoRide changed the way I travel. I commute Paris-Lyon every week and save over €150 per month while reducing my carbon footprint."
home.testimonial2_text: "As a driver, it's wonderful to share my trips. The credit system is transparent and I've met amazing people along the way."
home.testimonial3_text: "The option to filter for electric vehicles is brilliant! I can travel with peace of mind knowing my trip is 100% green."
home.credit_description: Forget complicated bank transfers. Our credit system makes payments instant and secure.
home.credit_step1_desc: Get 20 free credits upon sign-up to start traveling right away
home.credit_step2_desc: Use your credits to book a carpool. The price is set by the driver
home.credit_step3_desc: As a driver, receive credits for each passenger you transport
home.cta_subtitle: Join thousands of travelers who chose eco-friendly carpooling
home.cta_bonus: 20 free credits on sign-up — No credit card required

legal.title: Legal Notice
legal.editor_content: EcoRide — Eco-friendly carpooling platform. Educational project developed as part of a training program. This site is not a commercial business.

legal.intellectual_property_content: All content on this site (texts, images, logos, icons) is protected by intellectual property law. Any reproduction, even partial, requires prior authorization.
legal.data_protection_content: In accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), you have the right to access, rectify and delete your personal data. The data collected (name, email, trip information) is used solely for the operation of the platform. To exercise your rights, contact us at contact@ecoride.fr.
legal.cookies_content: This site uses technical cookies necessary for the proper functioning of the platform (authentication, language preferences). No advertising or tracking cookies are used.
legal.liability_content: EcoRide makes every effort to ensure the accuracy of information published on this site. However, EcoRide cannot be held responsible for errors, omissions or results obtained from the use of this information.
legal.contact_content: For any questions regarding the legal notice, you can contact us by email at contact@ecoride.fr.
